name: Planted Thread
description: Plant a thread of soul force in open air and learn at once when a soul crosses it.

name: Buried Cinch
description: Bury a cinch of soul force so deep it shows no trace until a soul steps into it.

name: Dull Bite
description: Let a dull bite of soul force follow the tripped line into the one who touched it.

name: Bracing Knot
description: Knot soul force tight about the self so a binding thrown by a foe finds no hold.

name: Seized Footing
description: Tie a planted line round a target's stride so it stumbles as its footing of will goes slack.

name: Marked Snag
description: Leave a snag of soul force on a foe crossing the line so its path can be felt long afterward.

name: Waiting Snare
description: Plant a snare of soul force in open air that closes on the first soul to cross it and holds it fast.

name: Harrowing Barb
description: Spring a barb of soul force down the snare line that drives past soul guards into the one caught.

name: Rune Sense
description: Read the faint pull of a seeded rune to learn whether a soul stands near its edge.

name: Seed Press
description: Press a seed of soul force into a target's gathering technique so the technique fails to bloom.

name: Quick Glyph
description: Mark a quick glyph of soul force before a target's eyes so it misjudges distance and direction.

name: Glyph Cover
description: Mark a glyph of soul force at the brow that turns a soul strike off its line.

name: Spreading Rune
description: Let a seeded rune spread its force over the souls near it until their will presses low.

name: Sleeping Sigil
description: Leave a sigil of soul force asleep until a soul crosses it and then hold that soul in place.

name: Sigil Thorn
description: Wake a seeded sigil so a spike of soul force leaps into the soul that woke it.

name: Seeded Rune
description: Sow runes of soul force across a wide patch of air that together bind every soul entering it.

name: Unfolding Glyph
description: Unfold a glyph of soul force that leaves a lingering taint on souls it touches and dulls their senses.

name: Lattice Hearing
description: Hold a thin lattice of soul force high and quiet and feel which crossings shake it.

name: Poised Strand
description: Poise a strand of soul force to drop on a target that steps out of line.

name: Keen Barb
description: Fire a keen barb of soul force from the lattice into the soul that shook it.

name: Lattice Stanchion
description: Draw the lattice close round the self so a pushing will meets many thin bars.

name: Stooping Weft
description: Drop a weft of soul force from above onto a target so it is pinned in a net at once.

name: Raking Barbs
description: Sweep the lattice through a group of souls in one pass so each is raked by thin barbs.

name: Patient Lattice
description: Hold a lattice of soul force open across a wide span that closes on any soul entering after the user withdraws.

name: Talon Cinch
description: Close a talon of soul force over a target's core of will so its technique cannot be drawn.

name: Ripple Reading
description: Gather soul force like still water and feel the ripples of any soul moving near it.

name: Settled Latch
description: Let a latch of soul force lie still until a soul disturbs it and then snap shut on that soul.

name: Sunk Barb
description: Raise a sunk barb of soul force from stillness into the soul that stirred it.

name: Calm Cover
description: Lay a calm cover of soul force about the self that swallows the force of a mental push.

name: Rising Spring
description: Release a sleeping spring of soul force so it rises in a ring and strikes every soul near it.

name: Tide Bind
description: Draw a rising tide of soul force over a target's limbs to bind them for several breaths.

name: Creeping Seep
description: Let soul force seep slowly into a target's will and sap its drive.

name: Sleeping Spring
description: Seed a sleeping spring of soul force in open air that wakes on contact and floods the soul that woke it.

name: Flooding Seal
description: Flood a target's soul with held force so the techniques it reaches for fail to rise.

name: Breeze Thread
description: Float a breeze-thin thread of soul force and feel it bend when a soul moves into its range.

name: Slipknot Hitch
description: Throw a slipknot of soul force that tightens the harder a target pulls against it.

name: Gust Barb
description: Fling a barb of soul force on a gust of intent against a soul at range.

name: Swerve Cover
description: Cast a thread across a soul strike to bend it past on a swerve.

name: Windward Hitch
description: Hook a thread of soul force on a mark and let it haul the body a stride.

name: Bound Gust
description: Bind a target with threads that bite deeper each time it twists against them.

name: Scattering Burr
description: Scatter burrs of soul force through a target's senses so every direction feels wrong.

name: Hauling Hook
description: Hook a target's gathering technique and haul it apart in a single pull.

name: Sworn Snare
description: Lay a snare of soul force that stays unmoved by wind or step and snaps on any soul crossing it.

name: Shearing Tangle
description: Tangle soul force into a mass that clings to any soul touching it and drags its force down.

name: Tangle Hearing
description: Spread soul force into a loose tangle and feel each strand shiver as souls brush it.

name: Open Cinch
description: Throw an open cinch of soul force that closes on a target's arm when it reaches.

name: Sharp Tine
description: Let a plain tine of soul force stab into the soul that moved the tangle.

name: Tangle Cover
description: Fold a tangle of soul force about the self so a pushing will loses its way in it.

name: Brisk Cord
description: Snap a cord of soul force to a mark and spring away along it.

name: Hindering Mesh
description: Spread a mesh of soul force that presses down every soul caught in it and slows their thought.

name: Wrenching Cinch
description: Wrench a cinch of soul force tight on a target to pull it off balance.

name: Tangle Surge
description: Surge force down the whole tangle so every soul within it is struck at once.

name: Open Tangle
description: Spread a vast tangle of soul force that stands unhidden and holds every soul that wanders into it.

name: Barbed Reckoning
description: Charge the tangle with barbs of soul force that grind a caught soul's will down with each struggle.
